image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a cooked meatloaf resting in a metallic baking pan. The loaf is oblong with a browned, textured exterior crust and a visible cross-section at the front end showing a dense, pinkish-tan interior with speckles of herbs or vegetables. A reddish glaze is visible on parts of the surface and pooling slightly at the base.

The curvature of the pan rim seems slightly inconsistent with the angle of the loaf, suggesting minor geometric warping common in AI generations, but not structurally catastrophic.
